input.summary:
Implemented a complete in-memory Task Management API in TypeScript with an event-driven architecture.

Key components:
- Event Bus (src/event-bus.ts): Simple publish/subscribe with typed event payloads. Includes task/comment event types and an enriched comment event.
- Services (each in its own file):
  - UserService (src/services/user-service.ts) — CRUD for users
  - ProjectService (src/services/project-service.ts) — CRUD + member add/remove
  - TaskService (src/services/task-service.ts) — CRUD, status transitions enforcement, assignment; publishes events and enriches comment events with assignee
  - CommentService (src/services/comment-service.ts) — CRUD for comments; publishes comment.added events
  - NotificationService (src/services/notification-service.ts) — Subscribes to events and creates notifications. Handles task assignment, status change, creation, deletion, and enriched comment notifications.
- API Router (src/router.ts): Pure HTTP layer using Node’s http and url modules. Routes:
  - Users: GET/POST /users, GET/PUT/DELETE /users/:id
  - Projects: GET/POST /projects, GET/PUT/DELETE /projects/:id, POST/DELETE /projects/:id/members
  - Tasks: GET/POST /tasks (filter by projectId), GET/PUT/DELETE /tasks/:id, PUT /tasks/:id/status, PUT /tasks/:id/assign
  - Comments: GET/POST /comments (filter by taskId), GET/DELETE /comments/:id
  - Notifications: GET /notifications (filter by userId), PUT /notifications/:id/read
- Bootstrap and Main:
  - src/bootstrap.ts wires services and router and returns an http server.
  - src/main.ts starts the server (runnable with npx tsx src/main.ts).
- Demo script (src/demo.ts): Starts the server in-process, exercises all features end-to-end (users, projects, membership, tasks, assignment, status changes, comments, notifications, marking read), then shuts down.

Additional:
- In-memory storage (Maps/arrays) only; no external packages used at runtime.
- Node type shims (src/node-shims.d.ts) to avoid requiring @types/node for compilation.
- tsconfig.json provided.

Note: The environment here does not have TypeScript installed, so `npx tsc --noEmit` cannot be executed in this sandbox. The code is structured to type-check without external node type packages using provided shims. To run locally:
- Start server: npx tsx src/main.ts
- Run demo: npx tsx src/demo.ts
